assumptions.afs_duration_basis: illustrative aggregate sensitivity, not a fitted security tape or use of the later sold-subset duration
assumptions.behavioral_calibration: none; stress sensitivities only, no estimated run probability
assumptions.interest_and_operations: zeroed to isolate liquidity and mark mechanics; no Jan-March NII, principal runoff, origination, deposit trend, hedge or fee forecast
assumptions.opening_net_loans: frozen net carrying value; gross loan and allowance retained as source facts, not credit/CECL modeling
assumptions.other_assets: fixed-value ledger placeholders, not priced securities
assumptions.event_calendar: day 0 = March 6 proxy, day 2 = March 8 sale, day 3 = March 9 withdrawals, day 4 = March 10 requested outflows; December 31 balances held unchanged until these events
assumptions.sale_size_interpretation: USD 21bn treated as cash proceeds in proxy; disclosure rounded and security-level proceeds/costs unavailable
assumptions.sale_cost_allocation: pro-rata year-end AFS cost and fair value; actual sold subset unavailable
assumptions.tax_sensitivity_basis: March 8 Q1 guidance, retrospective comparison only; no immediate tax-refund liquidity assumed
assumptions.htm_sale_counterfactual_basis: no HTM sale occurred; USD 5bn of proceeds for liquidity after all free AFS is an illustrative trigger for the asc320-htm-v1 rule with zero materiality, priced at the disclosed year-end HTM fair value
assumptions.parent_cash_outside_bank_basis: assumed sweep, not an observation; the parent-only condensed balance sheet in the 10-K is not transcribed here, and all positions and debt remain in one bank-and-subsidiaries account
assumptions.liquidity_rule_applicability: LCR and NSFR declared not_applicable: SVB was not subject to either at failure (fed_regulation source); no proxy ratio is computed or compared
assumptions.htm_funding: none in base; optional capacity/lag counterfactuals assume sufficient eligible unencumbered HTM with 5% haircut, not historical access
assumptions.regulatory_ratios: native treasury calculations use disclosed eligible capital and aggregate RWA; no bottom-up RWA or eligibility validation; daily ledger ratios are proxies and not reported as SVB capital

limitations: Bank-only runs open from the year-end Call Report; there is no bank-only observation after it and no January-March roll-forward
Opening book totals and HTM fair values are inputs, not predicted outcomes
No security/depositor tape, observed bank-specific histories, historical OAS or MBS prepayment calibration
No Jan-March balance-sheet roll-forward, NII forecast, credit/default calibration or hedges
Run size/date exogenous in replay; behavioral sensitivities uncalibrated; no probability estimate
Daily time steps do not model intraday payment, collateral-transfer or discount-window cutoffs
Negative cash measures unpaid funding need; not a completed withdrawal financed by a hidden overdraft
March 10 expected withdrawals are a hypothetical obligation; receivership interrupts actual flows
The tax bridge applies one guided rate to all AFS OCI; other AOCI components are a derived residual, not the disclosed breakdown
The CET1 bridge uses only components identifiable in the reference facts; its residual is unexplained and no deferred-tax or other regulatory adjustments are itemized
HTM reclassification applies the research asc320-htm-v1 rule to an assumed sale; no HTM sale occurred, and management intent, auditor judgment and tax are not modelled
Parent cash outside the bank is an assumed sweep, not the disclosed parent-only balance; all positions and debt stay in one bank-and-subsidiaries account
LCR and NSFR are declared not applicable and are not computed; the Fed retrospective estimates are quoted, not reproduced; no SLR or TLAC validation
Funding access, sale settlement, tax realization, actual legal-entity balances and intraday run timing remain material unknowns
